title: ID0473972-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP/RD170003092] Charging converter grouping in loop
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  Charger stuck in loop of converter grouping-fastshutdown check- mccb switch on.
Solution:  Ticket owneré comment `
We cleared the error flags by fixing the loosen cables
on the dispenser XD202 terminal.`´
The charger is error free.
